prompt.content:
You are a power-market analyst computing the economic readout of a lossless DC network at its least-cost dispatch.

Network: 8 buses, numbered 0 to 7. Bus 0 is the PRICING REFERENCE BUS: every price decomposition below is defined against bus 0 and nothing else.

Transmission lines. Each line is DIRECTED for sign conventions, stated from -> to. Flow physics: lossless DC power flow; power divides across parallel paths in inverse proportion to reactance; each flow limit applies to |flow| in BOTH directions.
  Line 0: from bus 0 to bus 1, reactance 0.2039 p.u., limit 33 MW
  Line 1: from bus 0 to bus 2, reactance 0.3294 p.u., limit 34 MW
  Line 2: from bus 0 to bus 3, reactance 0.3707 p.u., limit 48 MW
  Line 3: from bus 0 to bus 5, reactance 0.1299 p.u., limit 359 MW
  Line 4: from bus 0 to bus 7, reactance 0.3469 p.u., limit 320 MW
  Line 5: from bus 1 to bus 3, reactance 0.2201 p.u., limit 325 MW
  Line 6: from bus 1 to bus 4, reactance 0.1116 p.u., limit 39 MW
  Line 7: from bus 1 to bus 5, reactance 0.2626 p.u., limit 57 MW
  Line 8: from bus 1 to bus 7, reactance 0.2108 p.u., limit 58 MW
  Line 9: from bus 2 to bus 3, reactance 0.3517 p.u., limit 45 MW
  Line 10: from bus 2 to bus 4, reactance 0.2358 p.u., limit 78 MW
  Line 11: from bus 2 to bus 5, reactance 0.1204 p.u., limit 266 MW
  Line 12: from bus 2 to bus 6, reactance 0.0546 p.u., limit 56 MW
  Line 13: from bus 2 to bus 7, reactance 0.1406 p.u., limit 24 MW
  Line 14: from bus 3 to bus 4, reactance 0.3542 p.u., limit 60 MW

  Line 17: from bus 4 to bus 7, reactance 0.0583 p.u., limit 46 MW
  Line 18: from bus 5 to bus 6, reactance 0.2464 p.u., limit 56 MW
  Line 19: from bus 5 to bus 7, reactance 0.1185 p.u., limit 22 MW

Generators (offers in $/MWh). Each generator can produce anywhere in [0, pmax] MW: there is NO minimum output, pmin = 0 by design.
  Gen 0: at bus 1, offer 42.58 $/MWh, pmax 129 MW
  Gen 1: at bus 3, offer 16.56 $/MWh, pmax 176 MW
  Gen 2: at bus 2, offer 54.05 $/MWh, pmax 115 MW
  Gen 3: at bus 5, offer 107.72 $/MWh, pmax 176 MW
  Gen 4: at bus 7, offer 28.09 $/MWh, pmax 70 MW

Loads (integer MW per bus; total 429 MW):
  Bus 0: 114 MW
  Bus 1: 0 MW
  Bus 2: 79 MW
  Bus 3: 0 MW
  Bus 4: 65 MW
  Bus 5: 0 MW
  Bus 6: 65 MW
  Bus 7: 106 MW

Compute, at the least-cost dispatch:
1. lmp_usd_per_mwh: the locational marginal price LMP_i at every bus -- the marginal cost, in $/MWh, of serving +1 MW of load at bus i.
2. congestion_usd_per_mwh: the decomposition against reference bus 0. energy := lmp[0] and congestion[i] := lmp[i] - lmp[0], so congestion[0] must be exactly 0.0. The network is lossless DC, so the loss component that real ISO LMPs carry is identically zero and omitted.
3. binding_lines: the indices of lines congested with nonzero shadow price -- exactly the set {k : |mu[k]| > 0.01 $/MWh}, in ascending order, no duplicates.
4. mu_usd_per_mwh: line k's shadow price in $/MWh, SIGNED by the line's stated from->to orientation. Worked example: if line 2 runs from bus 1 to bus 3 and is congested in the 1->3 direction with shadow price $12.50/MWh, then mu[2] = +12.50; congested 3->1 means mu[2] = -12.50. Report mu[k] = 0.0 for EVERY non-binding line: a spurious 0.02 on a slack line excluded from binding_lines fails the support identity and forfeits all price credit.

Array order: lmp_usd_per_mwh and congestion_usd_per_mwh in bus order 0..7 (8 values each); mu_usd_per_mwh in line order 0..19 (20 values).

Report all prices to 2 decimal places; identities are checked to about +/-0.02-0.05 $/MWh -- target exact values.

Warning: quoting one uniform price at every bus is wrong whenever a line is congested.

Respond with your final answer as JSON on the last line, exactly one flat object with all four keys:
{"lmp_usd_per_mwh": [<8 floats>], "congestion_usd_per_mwh": [<8 floats>], "binding_lines": [<ascending line indices>], "m
